issues: weekly-class-select is hidden when API returns 0 classes with attendance; visible only after some attendance exists. Expected behaviour but noted.

jadwal-class-select had 0 <option> children for super_admin on this fresh DB — the page relies on classes being present AND having a selected id; works once a class is chosen externally. Jadwal modal + TimeSelect still open via jadwal-add-btn.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5788 lines; recommend router split (attendance, face, schoolgram, cron) for maintainability.
Face enroll uses mean-of-descriptors + L2 threshold 0.42/0.45; endpoints enforce 3-20 sample list and detect similar classmates with helpful 409 + confirm_similar escape hatch.
Cron endpoints correctly ack 200 immediately and offload actual work to BackgroundTasks; secret compared with hmac.compare_digest (constant-time).
Idempotency via X-Webhook-Id stored in db.cron_runs is clean.
Attendance scan uses atomic find_one_and_update upsert to prevent duplicate races at multiple gate stations.
/api/attendance/{aid} DELETE restricts to today only (good; prevents deleting historical records).
